title: Davante Adams Just Called Pat Surtain 'The Best' , Until His Teammate Showed Up - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Worbowski ,
1 days ago trophy logo on gradient background — Created by the Sports On Tap desk | Source : Sports On Tap (team logos property of their respective owners) Pat Surtain and Davante Adams are squaring off for the fifth time in their careers this Sunday Night Football, and if you think this is just another Week 3 matchup, you haven’t been paying attention to the fireworks these two create. This isn’t just about X’s and O’s; it’s about a high-stakes rivalry built on trash talk, epic plays, and evolving respect between two of the league’s best.
Remember When Adams Said Surtain “Isn’t There Yet”? Let’s rewind to the early days. Pat Surtain was just getting his feet wet, and Davante Adams, a seasoned vet, absolutely owned him. Their second showdown was brutal for PS2: he gave up four receptions for 85 yards and two touchdowns to Adams. The worst part? That included the game-winning score. Adams, never one to shy away, famously trolled the young cornerback, dropping the iconic line, “He’s not there yet.” Ouch. Talk about a brutal wake-up call, right?
From “Hardest DB” to “My Guy McDuffie” , Adams’ Wild Take But Surtain, true to his incredible talent, didn’t stay “not there yet” for long. He bounced back in 2023 when the Broncos went up against the Las Vegas Raiders. In their first meeting that year, PS2 locked Adams down, allowing only two catches for a measly 16 yards. Then, in the second game, Adams managed just three receptions for 26 yards. Those performances clearly earned Surtain serious street cred. Adams himself later called Surtain the “hardest defensive back to play against.” That’s high praise from one of the best receivers in the game!
Here’s where it gets wild though. Adams still calls Surtain “one of the best DBs in the league,” and even admitted he considered Surtain *the* best before this current season. But now? He’s officially handed that coveted CB1 title to his own teammate, Trent McDuffie. Adams straight up said, “Before coming into this year and playing with Trent, I was saying (Surtain) was the best. That’s my guy (McDuffie), and I see him every day, and that’s no slight at Pat. I’ve had a chance to play against Pat quite a few times now, and I love his game, respect it. … he’s definitely up there as far as one of the ones I have the most respect for.” It’s a massive compliment that still pushes the narrative for his own guy.
What’s at Stake This Sunday? Pride, Respect, and Bragging Rights! So, what does PS2 have to say about all this high-level talk? He’s ready to rumble. “It’s going to be another battle on Sunday, [I’m] looking forward to it,” he said this week. You know he heard every word Adams said about McDuffie, and you know he wants to prove he’s still *the* guy. This isn’t just a regular Week 3 game; it’s a statement game. You do not want to miss this one. Catch all the action tonight at 6:20 p.m. MT on NBC!
